text: This is Slana. The on-chain arena on Solana.
Buy a ticket, and drop into a live room. It never closes.
Eat smaller players... Take what they carry... and grow.
Cash out whenever you like. The fee only touches your profit.
Bots carry no value. But when a bot eats you, your tokens spill as loot.
The Slana Pass is free to mint. Lower fees, Pass rooms, and a head start.
Every season, the top ten split the pool.
Fees split three ways. A fifth is burned. Players pay players.
